surface_verification.justification: Real transcript-derived content only becomes trustworthy end-to-end through the actual chain: JSONL fixture -> deriveActivityFeed() -> React render -> DOM. Ran client/e2e/flows/mission-feed-content.spec.ts against a real isolated Hono+Vite stack in headless Chromium: an unresolved AskUserQuestion shows the real question/options/terminal-CTA, a resolved one marks the matched option picked and hides the CTA, and a failing test command shows a status pill plus the bounded real-output excerpt (FAIL src/auth.test.ts, the assertion text). Attempt 1 hit one transient ECONNRESET on POST /api/projects (network flake, not an app defect); attempt 2 passed 3/3 cleanly via the orchestrator's own retry.
